Hi Oliver —

Great conversation this morning, appreciate you walking through the use case and data flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on contracting: 

Recap from our call:
- FinPort will use Redwood to power real-time text enrichment for transaction categorization.
- Data types discussed: account/transaction metadata, hashed PII for matching, and anonymized ML telemetry.
- FinPort prefers production isolation but is fine with standard hosting model so long as contractual protections and SCCs are in place.

Questions / asks we agreed on: 
1) Controller vs Processor: please confirm whether FinPort will be the Controller and Redwood will act as Processor for the services in scope. If there are any parts where FinPort wants to be a Processor, flag those.
2) SCC / DPA flavor: which SCC module does your legal team prefer for Controller->Processor flows (we typically ship a Processor-focused DPA with the EU SCC Annex for Processor scenarios). If you have a preferred module name/number please let us know.
3) SOC 2 & evidence: can you share the SOC 2 Type II attestation or expected delivery date? If you prefer a brief summary first, we can accept a SOC2 readiness statement and then the report.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: I’ve attached your questionnaire back to you (FinPort_VendorQ.xlsx) after filling the items we covered — can your procurement/legal confirm missing items and any required evidence?

Attachments I’ve included: Redwood_DPA_template_v1.docx (our starting DPA + SCC annex); the vendor questionnaire file you sent (FinPort_VendorQ.xlsx).

Proposed next steps & timeline:
- Oliver: confirm Controller/Processor mapping and preferred SCC module by EOD Monday (May 10).
- FinPort Legal: if possible, send SOC2 attestation or an ETA for it (target May 10–12).
- Redwood (Dylan): will prepare an initial DPA draft as Processor Annex and circulate for redlines once we have your confirmation.
- Redwood (Grace): will build a short evidence packet (network diagrams, retention policy excerpt) for quick review.

If that aligns I’ll loop in our legal and CS leads now so they can prepare the draft and evidence pack. Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the DPA template. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Controller/Processor: FinPort will be Controller for customer transaction data, and we expect Redwood to be Processor.
2) SCC module: our legal team typically asks for the Processor-focused SCC annex under the EU Commission 2021 clauses (we don't have a strict "module number" preference, but they want wording that explicitly covers onward transfers and subprocessors).
3) SOC 2: we have a current SOC 2 Type II report (covering the relevant period) but procurement will only share the full report with vendors who have executed NDAs or DPAs. We can provide a SOC 2 attestation summary by Mon 2027-05-10 and full attestation after DPA steps.

FinPort Legal (cc): please see the attached vendor questionnaire (updated) — procurement will add any missing evidentiary items there.
